captions_note: built with CAPTIONS=0 in a reel: the reel's own captions stay on top of the feed, in the buyer's style
in_a_reel: CLIPS is a folder of the buyer's own videos, at least 8, each about 0.3 s after SKIP. No videos from the buyer = leave the effect out
the slot needs about 1 s before the word it brakes on and 0.2 s after it. The buttons are plain line drawings: no real product's look, no like or view numbers
steps: put the buyer's videos in the slot's clips folder and set WORD (the word it brakes on), HANDLE and FOLLOW in the CLIP block
run build.py SAFE=1 CAPTIONS=0      # prints the beats and the snapshot times
run check.py      # frame count, work/check/sheet.jpg, phone copy

buyer_folder.name: clips
buyer_folder.what: the buyer's own videos (mp4 or mov: their reels or clips). Only material they may show
